label: Set up
hint: Clear the table and lay out the cards, dice and markers again.
confirm: This clears the table and sets it up again. Continue?

label: Deal 3 each
hint: Three value cards into each person's hand.
announce: {name} dealt three cards to each person.

label: Reset
hint: Remove every card and all ink.
confirm: This removes every piece and all ink from the table. Continue?

label: Collect cards
hint: Every card back into the deck, face down, shuffled.
announce: {name} collected every card into the deck.
